subject: Trading
title: Bouncing Back After a Blow-Up
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Bouncing Back After a Blow-Up.

hook.text: You blew up your account. Lost 80%. It feels like the end. Many legendary traders went through this—and came back.

buildup.text: Jesse Livermore went bankrupt multiple times. Paul Tudor Jones's early losses shaped his risk management mastery.

discovery.text: A blow-up teaches what no book can: the visceral cost of ignoring risk. The lesson sticks for a career.

twist.text: The traders who return successfully all say the same thing: they traded smaller, slower, and with stricter rules.

climax.text: Starting over is not failure. Refusing to learn why it happened—that's failure.

punchline.text: A blow-up is tuition. Make sure you graduate.

quiz.question: What do traders who recover from blow-ups have in common?
options: They take bigger risks to recover faster
They trade smaller, slower, and with stricter rules
They switch to a different market
